title: One residue-field fibre controls the structure-sheaf unit at its base stalk
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Fix one point $s\in S$. Assume that the canonical map $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ is an isomorphism. Let $\eta:\mathcal O_S\to f_*f^*\mathcal O_S$ be the unit of the tensor-formula pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], with $f^*$ as in [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then the induced map $\eta_s$ on the stalk [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] at $s$ is bijective. There is no hypothesis about functions on the other fibres.

Both are applied to the same f, s and fibre isomorphism hypothesis.
